title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Training Note: Valuing a Training Week on an Extended Benefits Entitlement
content:
**What is a training week worth?** For an Extended Benefits (EB) entitlement on Unemployment Benefit Claims, each training week added to the entitlement is valued from the parent claim's weekly benefit amount and dependency allowance, according to the age of the parent's latest monetary determination: the number of calendar days from that determination date to the handling date.

| Parent claim | Age of the parent's latest monetary determination | Value of each training week |
|---|---|---|
| Carries a dependency allowance | No more than 21 days | The weekly benefit amount plus the full dependency allowance |
| Carries a dependency allowance | More than 21 days | The weekly benefit amount plus one half (0.5) of the dependency allowance, the half rounded to the cent |
| Carries no dependency allowance | Any | The weekly benefit amount |

**Where is the 21-day line?** A determination 21 days old gives the full allowance; at 22 days, one half.

**Hypothetical cases (weekly benefit amount 346.00).**

| Dependency allowance on the parent | Determination age | Value of a training week |
|---|---|---|
| 15.00 | 10 days | 361.00 |
| 15.00 | 40 days | 353.50 |
| None | Any | 346.00 |
